summary: Diff adds a new Contact page component, registers a `/contact` route under the existing AppLayout via TanStack Router, and updates the header Contact navigation to route to `/contact`. The Contact page displays the requested author name, book title, and Instagram/LinkedIn links with `target="_blank"` and `rel="noopener noreferrer"`.

hallucinated_features.description: Contact page includes an Email section with a `mailto:` button/link (authorsanakhan@gmail.com), which was not requested as part of the Contact page requirements.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest only requires name, book title, Instagram and LinkedIn links on the Contact page; it does not request adding an email contact section.

hallucinated_features.description: Additional UI/UX content on Contact page such as "Get in Touch" header text, "Latest Book" label, "Connect on Social Media" section label, and a closing paragraph.
hallucinated_features.reason: Not specified in the BuildRequest requirements/acceptance criteria; these are extra presentational additions.
